purpose: One bounded TypeSafe Jev decision policy. Frozen questions, closed labels, calibrated thresholds. Jev is read-only labeling; it never opens a gate.

chunk_filter.instructions: Does this transcript chunk contain a real review interaction (a change was sent to a reviewer, a reviewer verdict or finding was produced, or an author reaction/fix to a review), as opposed to general chat, copied policy text that merely mentions review, tool dumps, or meta-discussion of reviewer tooling without an actual review of a change?

criteria.review_interaction: A change was actually reviewed or a review verdict/finding/reaction for a specific change appears here.
criteria.meta_discussion: Talking about reviewers, review policy, or review tooling, but no change was reviewed in this chunk.
criteria.unrelated: No review of a change and no meta-discussion of review; general work, tool output, policy copy, or unrelated chat.

value_level.instructions: For this complete review interaction (dispatch or PR head, then reviewer verdict/finding, then author reaction or fix), what value did the review add to the work? Score the ordered levels only. Do not treat a mandatory safety-gate review that found nothing as discretionary waste; if the interaction is a mandatory safety review that found nothing, prefer the 'none' face level and the caller will bucket it separately.
criteria: negative: the reviewer identified something that ended up being wrong (author pushed back with evidence and the reviewer withdrew/softened, or the resulting fix was later reverted/undone as wrong)
none: the review added nothing of value or the arc is uncertain on value
low: only minor style or cosmetic suggestions
medium: named a real problem but did not know or give the solution
highest: named a real problem and gave a useful suggestion or fix
value_level.bucket_rule: mandatory_safety_gate interactions with face level none are counted in a separate assurance bucket, never as discretionary waste

usage_note: Calibration freezes thresholds and may rewrite instructions once on the tuning split only. A model_pin change invalidates calibration.
